Unwind at the Spa at Underscar just beyond Keswick, nestled in a stunning natural setting. Embark on a journey to serenity with our Serenity Half Spa Day, carefully crafted to envelop you in an oasis of calm. Immerse yourself in our facilities including: Pool, Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam Room, and Gym, as you escape into a world of  relaxation.

Choose your moment of bliss with a morning retreat from 9am to 1:15pm or an afternoon serenade from 1pm to 5:15pm. As you unwind, get cozy in the plush comfort of the provided towel, robe, and slippers and enjoy a light refreshment.

Elevate your sense of peace with a 30-minute treatment, where you have the choice between a soothing Back, Neck, and Shoulder Massage, a relaxing Walkers Leg Massage or a rejuvenating Germaine De Capuccini Express Facial. Each option is meticulously designed to restore harmony to both body and mind.
This tranquil escape is a sanctuary for those seeking a peaceful interlude.

This spa day package includes:
Use of the Pool, Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam Room and Gym
Morning 9am-1:15pm or Afternoon 1pm-5:15pm
Light refreshment includes a drink (hot drink or fresh orange/apple juice) and a slice of traybake  
Towel, robe and slippers
30 minute treatment.

ALL spa day guests MUST BE 16 years old and over.
